description: Donated to the University of Pretoria by the SAAF in 1996, reassembled in 2009 and placed on display at the Sci-Enza science centre on the Hatfield campus from 2010. Confirmed in place by a dated photograph of 15 October 2021 captioned at the University of Pretoria. Serial correction: the SAAF's own list places 210 at Sci-Enza and 212 at the CSIR, but the 2021 photograph and the August 2025 Mirage F1 monograph, which places 210 at the CSIR, both indicate the SAAF list has the two airframes transposed.
